title: Metallic (Resource Pack)
description: This is the resource pack designed for use with the Metallic progression overhaul datapack.
body:
This is the resource pack for the datapack/mod [Metallic](https://modrinth.com/datapack/metallic) by me. It is best used alongside the mod but can be used on its own if desired. By default this supports the [Bronze](https://modrinth.com/mod/bronze) mod.

Any version above 1.0 requires [Modefite](https://modrinth.com/mod/modefite-item-definition-backport). The resources will still load, but you will be using scaled down textures of larger swords for iron, bronze, and diamond tiers.

It changes the textures of all tools, as well as gold armor. Renames the stone tools to copper and the wooden tools to flint, as well as renaming gold armor to rose gold armor.

Credit for the palette goes to MR_CHOO, creator of the Recrafted resource pack.


If you would like to join the discord server dedicated to my projects, please message me on discord @gravitybreacher for an invite.

As always you are welcome to use this in your modpacks.
